# Step AB: rare parts load on first use

Lex (2026-11-16, Orbit TOOLS-311, pick 4 of the TOOLS-296 review): the parts of the editor a person uses rarely load the first time they are needed, the way the B-roll part does since step Z, so opening the editor downloads less. Nothing on screen changes. It waits with saving (step AA) for Lex's click-through before it goes live.

## What it does

- **The share room** (`public/together/room.js`, 35 KB) loads when the host first reaches Share to edit (the pointer over it, a press, or the keyboard focus on it, so the click seldom waits), or as soon as a guest's edit link opens (while the Join form shows). `together-adapter.js` loads it with `import()` and checks its seam version (`ROOM_SEAM` and `SEAM`).
  - The edit link is made and copied inside the Share to edit click, as before: its keys come from `public/together/link.js` (`newRoom`, `makeLink`, `parseLink`, the id and key rules), which loads at startup; `room.js` passes them on. The room with those keys starts once its part is here.
  - While the part is on its way, sharing counts as on (`together.sharing`: the agent may not open another script over it, its `open_script` is refused as before), while no room runs yet (`together.active`), so the person's own Undo still works; the app's Undo steps from before sharing end only when the room starts (`app.sharing(true)`). Stop sharing, or opening another script, drops it: no room starts and Undo keeps its steps. A guest's newer join replaces an older one still waiting.
  - A part that can't load (or speaks another seam version): the host's share ends (Undo keeps its steps) and the button itself shows it (TOOLS-311 release review): it takes the warning look (`data-failed`: the warning icon in the warning colour) and its name and tooltip say "Couldn't share. Click to try again." (or "Couldn't share. Reload the page." when the part is from a newer release, another seam version, which a retry cannot fix), at every width; hovering it keeps the warning look, a little stronger (release #68 second look, P3). When copying was blocked, the box to copy the link by hand opened while the part loaded closes and its link is cleared (release #68 second look, P2). A click on it asks for the part again (under a new address, as browsers keep a failed module) and shares as usual; this also holds when the share that met the failure had been stopped; a guest's Join says "Couldn't load the edit link. Reload the page." where the ended-link note shows.
  - The rest of working together (the adapter, `ops.js`, carets, the share button) stays at startup: the agent's caret uses it even when nothing is shared.
- **The export pack** (`public/export-pack.js`, with `zip.js` and the video-folder writer `video-folder.js`, 14 KB in all) loads when the Export menu opens (`beforetoggle`, so a menu opened and closed at once still asks for it). Export all and Save to video folder use it; a click waits for it if it is not here yet. The folder picker still opens inside the click; everything a save or a zip needs is read (for a save, copied: the document, the shots and the sketches) from the script before the pack is awaited, so it is the script as it was at the click that is exported, whatever is typed or opened meanwhile.
  - Its interface: `SEAM`, `zipAll(files)` (Export all) and `saveFolder({ dir, doc, scriptText, title, broll, modified, dirty })` (the folder written to `dir`, or the zip of it without one).
  - The note under "Save to video folder" and what a save needs of the B-roll list (`listState`, `settleFolder`, `folderNote`) moved to `public/folder-note.js`, which loads at startup; `video-folder.js` passes them on.
  - A pack that can't load (or speaks another seam version): Export all and Save to video folder both say "Couldn't load. Reload the page." on the item (a new note under Export all, hidden otherwise) until a reload, and neither downloads or writes anything. A note inside Export all takes the orange button's dark text, at rest, hovered and pressed, in light and dark (release #68 second look, P2: the muted grey read at 2.4:1 and 1.2:1).
- Not moved: the agent link section of `app.js` (the review: it starts only once a token is stored, but it is woven through the asks, answers and the agent's script tools, and needs a step-Z-style move first).
- Cache and CSP (step Y): the new files are same-site module scripts (`script-src 'self'`) with `Cache-Control: no-cache` and an ETag; after a reload each answers 304.
- Sizes (the files the page needs before it runs, `index.html`'s module script and its static imports): before, 16 files and 468,623 bytes of JavaScript; now 15 files and 428,101 bytes (−40,522, −8.6 %); 428,763 bytes after the release review's share-button fix. On first use: `together/room.js` 34,578, `export-pack.js` 1,696, `video-folder.js` 8,786, `zip.js` 3,123 bytes.

## Where

`public/together/link.js` (new), `public/together/room.js`, `public/together/share-button.js` (`fail(text)`; a copy that lands after sharing ended no longer says "Link copied"), `public/together-adapter.js` (`createTogether(app, { loadRoom })`, `preload()`), `public/export-pack.js` (new), `public/folder-note.js` (new), `public/video-folder.js`, `public/app.js` (the export pack's loader, Export all and Save to video folder, the guest's note, `together.preload()` for a guest's link), `public/index.html` (`#zipNote`). Tests: `tests/rare-parts.test.mjs`. Browser check: `scripts/smoke-rare-parts.mjs`.

## Browser check

`scripts/smoke-rare-parts.mjs` on `wrangler dev` (it applies `_headers` and runs the rooms) and headless Chrome, at 1280 and 390 px with real clicks, watching every request: a new script with typing fetches none of `together/room.js`, `export-pack.js`, `video-folder.js`, `zip.js` (and does fetch `together/link.js` and `folder-note.js`); opening the Export menu loads the pack, Export all downloads the script's zip (it starts with "PK") and no note shows; the pointer over Share to edit fetches `room.js` before any click (1280 px), Share to edit copies the edit link, loads `room.js`, and the room started is the one in the copied link, with "Link copied" and Stop sharing; the guest's link loads `room.js` while the Join form shows (and no export pack), the guest joins and gets the host's text, the host sees the guest; Stop sharing ends the room; after a reload each of the four files answers 304 on the wire; with `room.js` held, the link is still copied in the click, sharing shows as on with no room, Ctrl+Z undoes the person's typing, and Stop sharing before the part comes starts none and keeps the Undo steps from before the share; with `room.js` and `export-pack.js` refused, the share button says "Couldn't share. Click to try again." and sharing is off, and hovering it keeps the warning look, Export all and Save to video folder say "Couldn't load. Reload the page." and Export all downloads nothing, the note under Export all reads at 4.5:1 or more on the orange in light and dark at rest, hovered and pressed, and a guest's Join says "Couldn't load the edit link. Reload the page."; with copying blocked and `room.js` held, then refused, the copy-by-hand box closes and its link is cleared; with `export-pack.js` held, Export all clicked and then another script opened downloads one zip, of the script of the click; a pack refused after the video folder was picked writes nothing to it and the item says to reload; a folder saved while the pack is held, with more typed meanwhile, holds the script as it was at the click in `script.md`, `prompter.md` and `recording-notes.md`. No CSP violation and no page error. The older suites run on the same server. Evidence: `docs/agents/evidence/tools-311-browser.txt`.

## Done

Feature list: rare parts load on first use with no change on screen; the release review added one line under Working together (the share button's failed state, and a click tries again); release #68's second look changed its words and added the copy-by-hand box closing

### Proof

- Failing tests first: met. `tests/rare-parts.test.mjs` failed 8 of 9 on `origin/dev` (`together/room.js`, `zip.js` and `video-folder.js` among the startup files; no `export-pack.js`, `together/link.js` or `folder-note.js`; the share room started at once in the click). The ninth (a share stopped before the part arrives starts no room) is a guard that held already. With the change all 9 pass; review round 1 added two (a room part with another seam version, for the host and a guest; a copy that lands after sharing failed), 11 of 11; the GPT second look's fix added one (a share stopped before its part failed: the next click says to reload, failing first on the old adapter), 12 of 12; the last second look's fix added one (the pointer or the focus on Share to edit fetches the part), 13 of 13 (four of them changed with the next fix: the app's Undo is cleared only when the room starts; they failed on the previous head and pass now), and `kit specs` passed 477 of 477; the release review's share-button fix added two unit tests and changed two (`tests/rare-parts.test.mjs` 15 of 15), and `kit specs` passes 479 of 479.
- The first load carries none of these parts: met. The startup files went from 16 files, 468,623 bytes, to 15 files, 428,101 bytes (−8.6 %); `tests/rare-parts.test.mjs` checks the four files are not among them. In headless Chrome, `smoke-rare-parts.mjs` saw no request for any of them while a new script was opened and typed in, at 1280 and 390 px.
- Each part loads on first use and works: met. `smoke-rare-parts.mjs` 92 ok, 0 fail before the release review, 112 ok, 0 fail after its share-button fix (the pointer over Share to edit, Undo while the room's part is held and after that share is stopped, the Export menu, Export all, Share to edit with a guest, a held room, a held pack with a script switch, a folder saved while the pack is held, refused parts, a pack refused after the folder picker, 304 after a reload). The older suites on the same server, run again after each fix round (the last after 0414a67): `smoke-csp` 51 ok (0 CSP violations), `smoke-saving` 73 ok, `smoke-broll-lazy` 91 ok (its 1280 px "another script" step, a click on "New script" in the script menu, timed out in 2 of 6 full-suite runs right after other suites; alone it passed 4 of 4 on this branch and 3 of 3 on `origin/dev`), `smoke-video-folder` 93 ok, `smoke-keep-all` 933 ok, `smoke-room` 27 ok, `smoke-relay` 42 ok.
- A plain error line on a load failure: met. With the requests refused, the share button, Export all, Save to video folder and a guest's Join each said to reload (`smoke-rare-parts.mjs`), with no page error.
- A folder saved while the pack loads holds the script as it was at the click (GPT second look, P2): met. With the copy taken out, `smoke-rare-parts.mjs` failed at both widths (`script.md` had "Hello there my friend." while `prompter.md` had "Typed later." too); with it, every file holds the text of the click.
- A share stopped before its part failed says so on the next click (GPT second look, P2): met. The new unit test failed on the old adapter (the label stayed "Share to edit") and passes now; since the release review the next click asks for the part again, and says to reload if it fails again.
- A failed share shows on the button itself (release review R1, P2): met. `smoke-rare-parts.mjs` failed first on `origin/dev` at 1280 px (no `data-failed`, the share icon unchanged, the text colour unchanged, no retry: 7 failures) and passes at 1280 and 390 px now (112 ok, with `smoke-csp` 51 ok and `smoke-room` 27 ok run again on the same server; `docs/agents/evidence/tools-311-browser.txt`): with `room.js` refused, the button is marked `data-failed`, shows the warning icon in place of the share icon, takes the warning colour of the save line's error, and its accessible name (from Chrome's accessibility tree) is "Couldn't share. Reload the page."; with the network back, a click asks for `room.js` again, copies a link, starts the room in that link and the failed look goes; after Link copied the button has the plain sharing look with the link icon. Four unit tests fail on the old code (`d4dd99e`, 11 pass, 4 fail) and pass now (the button's failed look; a retry after a failed part; a retry after a stopped share's failed part; a part that failed during the hover, then a click).
- A clipboard write from a share that failed, landing after its retry, stays silent (GPT second look on the share-button fix, P2): met. The new unit test failed on the previous head (the copy-by-hand box opened with the first share's dead link) and passes now: only the latest click's copy shows Link copied or the copy-by-hand box, and a retry drops the failed look at once. `tests/rare-parts.test.mjs` 17 of 17 (review round 3 added a test for a stopped share's late copy), `kit specs` 481 of 481; `smoke-rare-parts.mjs` 112 ok, `smoke-csp` 51 ok and `smoke-room` 27 ok run again.

- Release #68 second look, P2: the copy-by-hand box closes on a failed load: met. ### Declined

- R2 (gap, now partly added): Undo while the room's part is held is checked in the browser since the last second look; opening another script then is unit-tested through the adapter's split (`active` for Undo, `sharing` for opening); a test gap.
- GPT second look (gap): a runtime check for an export pack with another seam version (`Fetch.fulfillRequest` with `SEAM = 2`). It throws into the same handler as a refused request, which is checked at both widths; a test gap.
- Second look in `kit pr` (P2 race, the part left): a guest who joins in the moment between the copied link and the host's room reaching the server is refused as "ended" (`worker/room.js:84`: a room with no note yet). That moment was there before this step on `origin/dev` too: the link is copied in the click, before the host's socket has connected and made the room. This step widened it by one file's download, which the fetch on hover, press or focus now takes away in practice; the link has to reach another person, who opens it and types a name, before a guest can join. Telling a room that waits for its host from an ended one, with a retry for guests, is a change to the room protocol and the Worker, outside this step.
- Second look in `kit pr` (gaps): an early guest with the host's part held, Undo while it is held, a linked list's snapshot while the pack is held, and an export pack with another seam version: test gaps (the paths are unit-tested or share a checked handler).
- R3 (nit): `const list` in `saveToFolder` shadows the outer `list`; kept, it reads as the B-roll module's list there.
- R4 (gaps and nit): tests for the hover fetch with no script open and for a part that fails during the hover (the click then says to reload at once, copying nothing, which is what a failed part should do); the 1280 px "Share to edit loads together/room.js" line now follows the hover fetch (390 px still checks the click starts it); a hover-time failure (since the release review the click asks for the part again). Test gaps and a rare path.
- Release review of the share-button fix, round 3 (P3): while a slow clipboard write is pending, a retry shows the sharing look at once and a first share keeps "Share to edit". Kept: the retry must drop the failed look at once, and the first share keeps the approved Share to edit → Link copied flow; the write lands within a tick unless the browser asks for permission.

- Review round 1 of the release #68 fixes (nit): "Click" in "Couldn't share. Click to try again." on a phone or with Enter. Kept: Lex chose these words.
- Review round 1 of the release #68 fixes (nit, code not changed here): the copy-by-hand box stays open when Stop sharing is reached with the keyboard. A click elsewhere closes it, as for any popover; the task covers a failed load only.
